newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore rubber futures close higher across board.
newsitem.headline: Singapore rubber futures close higher across board.

text.p: Rubber futures closed higher across the board on Thursday in moderate trade on some late local buying interest in line with higher Japanese prices, brokers said.
Prices in Tokyo and Kobe were marked up slightly, helped by a weak yen and supported by news that Japan's rubber stocks as of December 20 were down 2,419 tonnes from December 10.
"There wasn't any trade in the morning due to lack of fresh incentives. But prices were marked up slightly in the afternoon in sympathy with higher Japanese prices," a local broker said.
At around 0945 GMT, February RSS3 rose 0.25 cent to 125.75 U.S. cents a kg.
July/September rose 2.50 cents to 187.50 Singapore cents (US$1.34) a kg.
February TSR20 was indicated at 172.00 Singapore cents (US$1.23) a kg compared with last Monday's settlement of 171.75 cents.
